title: AiTM phishing to payment redirection (cyber-to-fraud)
description: Example scenario: an adversary-in-the-middle phishing kit steals a session cookie, the actor hides mailbox rules, then changes a payee's payment details. Crosses ATT&CK v20 and F3.

steps.description: Phishing link to an AiTM reverse-proxy login page
Reverse proxy relays credentials and MFA to the real IdP
Vendor payment details changed to a mule account
